notes: Black Forest Labs image and FLUX 3 video generation mirror upstream 2.0.84: `BFL_API_KEY`, `x-key` auth, custom base URL and headers, versioned user-agent suffix, `image`/`imageModel` and `video`/`videoModel` aliases, `black-forest-labs.image` and `black-forest-labs.video` provider IDs, `/v1/{model}` submit URLs, response-supplied polling with trusted `bfl.ai` sibling-host credential forwarding, signed result URLs, provider options and warnings, response/provider metadata, and structured errors. Video supports text-to-video, first/last/timed keyframes, continuation, draft generation/enhancement, and settled cost metadata. Unary generation remains source compatible; `AsyncVideoModel` adds serializable V4 start/status operations, stable idempotent start retries, and shared facade polling. BFL has no native webhook, so a supplied webhook warns and falls back to polling. Language and embedding families remain unsupported. The 2026-09-20 pass enforces wall-clock image polling deadlines that can abort a hung request. File/mask image capabilities are now exposed as async Bool? getters; unrecognized models remain unknown. The 2026-10-11 pass: FLUX 3 Image supports reference images, grounded prompts, resolution/ratio/seed mapping, terminal failure parsing and credential-isolated result downloads. The 2026-10-18 pass: Latest and future image IDs use the current model-specific submit protocol with file inputs, dimension/ratio/resolution controls and safetyTolerance up to 7; known legacy IDs retain their original protocols. The 2026-11-01 reviewed delta adds native per-request async credentials and current portable request/stream fixes where applicable; see WeeklyUpstreamAudit20261101 for exact package dispositions and retained gaps. The 2026-11-08 reviewed delta and retained gaps are documented in WeeklyUpstreamAudit20261108; no full-package or live-service parity is implied.
